changes.notes: Attendance Management, first chunk (API only, no screens yet): attendance sessions for a list (in person, online or offline); mark present by the Organizer or a co-organizer, or by the voter with a verified e-mail ID in an online session; one mark per voter per session; public counts with no personal data; every action in the signed audit trail; Excel template download and upload for an organizer with no Voter List. Migration 0009. Payment and package gating are not part of this change; the payment slot stays off. Not deployed yet.

First versioned release. Describes the existing state of the product as of the public snapshot: no behaviour change. Voter pages, Organizer and Host pages, draft and final (frozen, signed) lists, audit log, English and Hindi voter page, payment slot (off by default).
